card.name: Hyphen inside toll-free phone numbers
card.fires_on: The hyphen between the area code and the next digits in 1-800, 1-833 or 1-844 style toll-free numbers. It appears where a label gives a company or program phone number for reporting or information.

modes.label: Hyphen after 1-8xx
modes.description: The hyphen right after a toll-free prefix, before the first three digits of the number.
modes.example: Sandoz Inc. at 1-800-525<<->>8747 as soon as possible

modes.label: Non-breaking hyphen variant
modes.description: The same position when the number is written with special non-breaking hyphens.
